data.name: Haadee
data.gender_notes: Haadee is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haadee is a beautiful and delightful name, derived from the Arabic word 'hadee', which means 'pleasing to the senses' or 'beautiful'. It conveys a sense of growth, as the name is often associated with blooming flowers and lush gardens. The name Haadee carries the meaning “Delightful, beautiful, pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Haadee usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, beautiful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a name that evokes a sense of peace and tranquility, and serves as a reminder of the eternal and unchanging nature of Allah's love and mercy.
data.etymology: Haadee belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful, beautiful, pleasing.”
